test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question: Kritika walks 6 m towards the south. She turns right to walk 6 m. She turns left and walks 5 m. She again turns left and walks 6 m. Again she turns left and walks 5 m. In which direction is she facing now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Kritika walks 6 m towards the south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe17fb44c38e4bde3d16b4c7b1b7684b83100ca85fe178f4bb01009951c1ef54.png] 

2) She turns right to walk 6 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f12af4aa282bd2a7df96d266384c9ca036fcbbdb519ca2c67957279cbbdc1558.png] 

3) She turns left and walks 5 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/983e277fd30c4278b02aebff879bbf15ad5015b3244a2d85395cb10a27985b16.png] 

4) She again turns left and walks 6 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/055e4169c4e48b54af9a5ab979a6bf3129db75540bbeff9d96d8917ab1a010ee.png] 

5) Again, she turns left and walks 5 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/481ace3ce7e7e7fa0b35c618c98d308e5710c54b2f8fed0c7e74d20a163de4ee.png] 

Here, we can see that she is now facing North direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"North"**.
